note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, two key-word lines and one word stack, so 5 graphics and the end card. One text element on screen at a time. The video is made in both sizes: use the 16:9 / 9:16 switch.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top: “Problems too big to solve?”
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:11–00:14, small, lower left above the captions: “Vishal Ghotge” / CEO of Kiva.

mg.title: Key words

mg.title: Key words

mg.title: Who funds it

mg.title: End card
